scheme_name: ICAR - Post Matric Scholarship For Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribes Candidates
other_conditions: The applicant must be a citizen of India.

The applicant must be admitted to an agricultural university for an undergraduate degree program in Agriculture & Allied Sciences (e.g., B.Sc.(Agri.), B.V.Sc., B.Sc.(Agril. Engg.), B.Sc.(Home Science), B.F.Sc., B.Sc.(Forestry)).
benefits_summary: A scholarship of ₹1,000 per month plus a contingent grant of ₹750 per annum for tuition, books, uniforms, for the entire duration of the undergraduate program.
